facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 56°F at pass elevation.

facts.text: Snow left Ostrander Lake (8,200 ft) and Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) 16 to 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Ostrander Lake
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 24 (2023), May 28 (2024), May 17 (2025)

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: July 1 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 27 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Ostrander Lake (8,200 ft) and Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft).

evidence.name: Ostrander Lake
evidence.detail: 11.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 91.3 in (2023), 41.3 in (2024), 33.9 in (2025)

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: 7.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 54.4 in (2023), 16.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 1 and June 30, carried from the melt-out dates at Vogelsang (10,095 ft) and Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Vogelsang
evidence.detail: melted out May 15, 685 ft below the pass; points to April 30 to June 23

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 1,380 ft below the pass; points to May 3 to July 6
